reviews.text: Fotis is a great trainer who guided us perfectly so that we could have a beautiful everyday life and enjoy our walks with KOFI in peace...! We thank him very much and I definitely recommend him unreservedly...

I couldn’t recommend Nick highly enough! We did the puppy and obedience training and found Nick to be unbelievably patient. He gives clear directions that even our children could easily follow. He is evidently very experienced with practical suggestions that work for any problems/adjustments. Thanks to Nick’s training, having a new puppy has been a thoroughly enjoyable and easy experience and we now have a happy, relaxed dog that just fits in perfectly with the family.

Nick has been fantastic in helping me train my large male Boerboel. We started with the basics of obedience and behaviour training and he gradually helped us build up to a point where our dog is much more manageable on walks and better behaved in the house.

Given the size and strength of my dog, walks could be challenging, but Nick helped improve both Jabba’s behaviour and my confidence in handling him. The difference has been huge, and walks are now much more enjoyable.

Nick is an excellent trainer who is patient and knowledgeable. He cares about both the dog and the owner. I’d highly recommend him to anyone looking for help with their dog’s training and behaviour.

We recently worked with Nick on a 10 week course for our 3 miniature dachshunds - and the results have been life changing !

We had a combination of problems - reactivity, walking, socialisation, separation, toilet issues & general behaviour - Nick guided us through a 10 week course & the results have been tremendous.

We have gone from having 10+ wee’s in the house per day, to zero. We can now walk them without constant reactivity towards other dogs & pulling on the lead, they are calmer, happier & more compliant, displaying general far better behaviour & obedience.

I cannot recommend Nick & UK9 Training highly enough.

Thank you Nick

Mr. Fotis is an excellent trainer, with incredible patience, persistence and contagiousness. First of all, he managed to teach us how to handle Pluto, because… let's be honest, Pluto had "beaten" us for good! 😂 😂 😂
With his professionalism, kindness and patience, he made difficult things seem simple. We really thank him for all the effort!
Amazing Job from Foti, he is very calm at all times which really assisted us with the training and our puppy.

We had an excellent experience with UK9  trainer, who worked with Brumble in a very structured and thoughtful way, with the clear goal of helping her become comfortable enough to visit the vet and groomers.

The training started with the basics, building a strong foundation that gradually led towards our overall goal. What we particularly appreciated was that he always explained why each part of the training was important, which helped us understand Brumble better and made it much easier to continue the work at home.

He also took the time to look at Brumble’s food and overall wellbeing, taking a really holistic approach rather than focusing solely on training.

Most importantly, though, he didn’t just train our dog he trained us too!  He gave us the knowledge, confidence and practical tools we need to maintain everything we have achieved and continue building on it.

We would highly recommend UK9 to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, patient and genuinely caring dog trainer. The difference in Brumble has been fantastic, and we feel much more confident as owners as a result of the training.

We’re so glad we went with Nick and are incredibly grateful for the transformation we’ve seen in Teddy. Teddy is our 5-year-old Labrador who had become very reactive towards certain dogs. We’d tried training in the past, including puppy classes and one-off reactivity sessions, but the results never really stuck. After a difficult incident a couple of months ago, we knew we needed to take his training more seriously, so we decided to commit to Nick’s 10-week programme.The difference has been incredible. Teddy’s reactivity has reduced so much that it’s now completely manageable, and we feel much more confident and relaxed on walks. More importantly, Teddy seems much more confident and not stressed around other dogs.Nick also helped us with Teddy’s diet and getting him into better shape, which has made a huge difference too. The training methods were a bit challenging at first because we had barely set any boundaries from the start (we are big softies for Teddy), but they were exactly what we needed. Nick has been reassuring, encouraging, funny and incredibly knowledgeable throughout the whole process.We couldn’t recommend Nick enough, especially if you have a reactive dog. We’re so grateful for all his help! 🐾

First of all, I wanted to thank you publicly for your services and your manner of behavior when entering our space and outside. I think that my friend is demanding, she is a female pinscher, unfortunately I was not the right one for our relationship to develop, so I turned to you and I honestly feel that we were able to build a strong relationship with our 7-month-old puppy Fiona
She still needs work from me, but thanks to you, Fotis, I believe I can do even better with the advice and commands you taught me
Also, thank you very much for the relationship that developed and if I encounter any difficulties in the future, I will be able to call you to advise me
I appreciate you and recommend you unreservedly 😉
